rights_basis: Faithful bounded reading transcription of original-language liturgical text from Gregorian Hadrianum (Wilson 1915): complete strict Canon Missae constituent, whose United States copyright term has expired by publication date (1915 critical edition (mediating ninth-century Hadrianum witnesses R, C, O)). text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens deus iube haec perferri per manus angeli tui in sublime altare tuum in conspectu diuine maiestatis tuae ut quotquot ex hac altaris participatione sacrosanctum filii tui corpus et sanguinem sumpserimus omni benedictione caelesti et gratia repleamur per christum dominum nostrum
